lessons: The fence cannot be satisfied as written. The required bug-ticket fixture migration breaks tests/test_inbox.py::test_report_replay_to_regression at line 234, which adds its own Regression section and so duplicates it. That file is outside the fence, but the ticket's Verification still runs it.

Repair the ticket or plan first: under the same 19.L contradicted-test closure that already fences tests/test_fixture_host.py, add tests/test_inbox.py to the fence. Limit the change to migrating this one test so it consumes the migrated bug fixture instead of appending its own Regression section.

The migrated test_report_replay_to_regression must keep its report-custody and regression-overlay proofs, the same way the ticket's preservation rules keep base-test presence and defect failure. Do not weaken the production bug gate.

Before re-implementing, run every preservation command in Verification (test_inbox, test_triage, test_bug_gate, etc.) against the prototype fixture migration. Find any other unfenced caller of the fixture Author ticket before committing.
